name: Team Chimera
description:
Established in 2006, Team Chimera is the official electric racing team of RV College of Engineering (RVCE), Bengaluru. Over the years, the team has evolved from developing hybrid powertrains to engineering high-performance electric race cars that embody the principles of sustainable mobility and innovation. With a strong focus on design, simulation, testing, and manufacturing, Team Chimera develops custom-built vehicles and competes at national and international Formula Student events.

Rooted in RVCE’s legacy of engineering excellence, the team continues to push the boundaries of electric vehicle technology, performance, and sustainable transportation. Building on its achievements, Team Chimera participated in Formula Bharat 2026, held in Coimbatore in January 2026, and has already begun rigorous preparations for Formula Bharat 2027. As a testament to the team’s consistent performance and competitive standing, Team Chimera currently ranks 2nd among 45 teams, reflecting its strong technical capabilities and commitment to excellence.

events.name: Auction
events.detail: Test your strategic thinking and financial management in our high-stakes Auction challenge. Teams receive a virtual budget to bid on critical formula student components, balancing performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency to build the ultimate competitive racecar package under pressure, and tight constraints.

events.name: Egress
events.detail: Safety and speed are paramount in motorsport. The Egress test challenges participants to execute a standard driver emergency evacuation from our electric formula car as quickly as possible, demonstrating composure, physical agility, and strict adherence to competition safety regulations.

events.name: ARDUINO MINI PROJECT
events.detail: Dive into the world of onboard electronics and embedded systems. In this hands-on Arduino Mini Project, participants will wire, program, and troubleshoot a functional circuit or sensor module tailored for data acquisition and vehicle telemetry applications.

events.name: Assetto Corsa
events.detail: Experience the thrill of driving our very own Formula Student electric car in the virtual realm. Hop into our custom Assetto Corsa simulator setup, test vehicle dynamics on track, and set the fastest lap time against your peers
